‘Ma, they punched me’: Student’s last call to family; how horror unfolded at homestay
articles.summary: Nimisha Thakuria, a 22-year-old Gauhati University student, made a frantic phone call stating she could not breathe. After her family lost contact, she was found critically injured at a homestay on the outskirts of Guwahati.

articles.title: Former Keralam chief secretary Jiji Thomson alleges Gyanesh Kumar suggested BJP ticket
articles.summary: Jiji Thomson, a former chief secretary, revealed that Gyanesh Kumar suggested he join the BJP. The proposal occurred during a flight to New Delhi in 2016.

articles.title: OpenAI, Anthropic CEOs summoned by Australia Senate over AI agent breach
articles.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei have received written requests to appear at a public hearing in Canberra on Thursday, according to a spokesperson for Senator Sarah Hanson-Young, the Australian Greens lawmaker chairing the inquiry. Neither company immediately responded to requests for comment outside business hours.

articles.title: US deports LGBTQ migrants to nations where they fear persecution, rights groups say
articles.summary: The US department of homeland security has defended the arrangements, saying migrants receive due process and that third-country agreements are lawful. A federal appeals court this month upheld a ruling that found aspects of the administration's third-country deportation policy unlawful.

articles.summary: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback.

articles.title: Vishal suffers back injury during Purushan climax shoot in Goa
articles.summary: During an action shoot for 'Purushan' in Goa, actor Vishal suffered a back injury that requires immediate medical attention. Doctors have prescribed a recovery period of three weeks, leading to his disappointment as he will miss the important Nadigar Sangam general body meeting.

articles.title: Mohanlal's organic garden at his Elamakkara home
articles.summary: Mohanlal, the renowned actor, has nurturing an organic vegetable garden at his Elamakkara home in Kochi for years. During the 2021 lockdown, he engaged fans by sharing videos of his gardening endeavors, showcasing that even small spaces can yield fresh produce with methods like grow bags.

articles.title: Laura Bailey and Ian Alexander join ‘The Last of Us’ season 3 cast
articles.summary: In an exciting twist for 'The Last of Us' live-action series, Laura Bailey and Ian Alexander, famed for their voice work in the video game, have entered the cast. Bailey will embody Elizabeth, a formidable Seraphites leader, while Alexander takes on the role of Paco.

articles.title: 'Nikhila Vimal': 'Coming with ten cameras is difficult for me'
articles.summary: Nikhila Vimal has shared her discomfort regarding unexpected camera interactions while promoting her film 'Dhoomakethu'. She clarified that her reactions are based on her personal feelings and not directed at journalists.
